title: Ko te wairua i tukua o te mura tapu
intro: Kei mua i a koe tētahi kōrero mō te maia whakaharahara, i reira tētahi tangata i maia ai ki te wero i ngā whakapono tino pūmau o tētahi ao whānui. Whaia ēnei kōrero hāhā o mua, ā, ka hurahia e koe tētahi oranga kua tohua ki te whakapono pakari, te oranga whakamiharo, me te whakatakoto i ngā turanga hei hanga i te haerenga wairua o te tini miriona. Tātarihia marietia ia tohu - kei te maumahara tonu te ahi tapu.
clues: I whānau mai ahau i roto i tētahi whānau e karakia ana ki ngā mea o te rangi, ki ngā whakapakoko whakairo, heoi i roto i ahau i whakakahoretia ai ngā mea i karakiatia e rātou.
I tū atu ahau ki te aroaro o te rangatira nui rawa o tōku whenua, i wawahi i ngā whakapakoko i piko atu ai tōku iwi, me te kī anō ko te Kaihanga o ngā rangi anake e tika ana kia koropikohia.
I tonoa he tahunga ahi e mura ana i runga i tōku ingoa, engari i kauwhau ahau mā te Tangata e mahi ana ahau ko ia anake hei whakaora i ahau — ā, i whakahaua kia whakamatao, kia haumaru hoki ngā mura.

I mahue iho i ahau ngā mea katoa i mōhiotia e au i runga i te whakahau a te Atua, i a au e kopikopiko ana i roto i ngā awaawa maroke me tōku whānau, e whakawhirinaki ana ki tētahi kai kāore anō kia kitea e au.
I a māua e tū ana i te taha o taku tama matamua i roto i te awaawa pakoko, ka whakaarahia ngātahitia e māua te turanga o te whare tapu, he wāhi tapu i whakaritea mō te hunga katoa e ngohengohe ana.
E mōhiotia ana ahau ko Khalilullah — te hoa piripono o te Atua Aroha — ā, i honoa tonutia tōku ingoa ki te whakapono o te tuku me te ngākau ngohengohe.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
